local function getValidConfigName(name)
    local cleanName = name:gsub("[^%w_%-]", ""):sub(1, 20)
    if cleanName == "" then cleanName = "Config" end
    return cleanName
end

local function saveConfig(name)
    pcall(function()
        local safeName = getValidConfigName(name)
        local configsList = {}
        pcall(function()
            if isfile(ConfigFolder .. "/config_index.json") then

                elseif Config[k] ~= nil then
                    Config[k] = v

        end
    end)

local function createSlider(parent, text, min, max, defaultVal, callback)
    local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
    frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 64)
    frame.BackgroundColor3 = Config.SecondaryColor
    frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
    frame.Parent = parent
    
    local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
    c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
    c.Parent = frame
    
    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 55)
    stroke.Transparency = 0.5
    stroke.Parent = frame
    
    local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -90, 0, 28)
    lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 6)
    lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    lbl.Text = text
    lbl.TextColor3 = Config.TextColor
    lbl.TextSize = 13
    lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    lbl.Parent = frame
    
    local valLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    valLbl.Size = UDim2.new(0, 75, 0, 28)
    valLbl.Position = UDim2.new(1, -85, 0, 6)
    valLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    valLbl.Text = tostring(defaultVal)
    valLbl.TextColor3 = Config.AccentColor
    valLbl.TextSize = 13
    valLbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    valLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
    valLbl.Parent = frame
    
    local sliderBg = Instance.new("Frame")
    sliderBg.Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 8)
    sliderBg.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 40)
    sliderBg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 40)
    sliderBg.BorderSizePixel = 0
    sliderBg.Parent = frame
    
    local sbgc = Instance.new("UICorner")
    sbgc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    sbgc.Parent = sliderBg
    
    local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
    fill.Size = UDim2.new(math.clamp((defaultVal - min) / (max - min), 0, 1), 0, 1, 0)
    fill.BackgroundColor3 = Config.AccentColor
    fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
    fill.Parent = sliderBg
    
    local fc = Instance.new("UICorner")
    fc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    fc.Parent = fill
    
    local draggingSlider = false
    local function updateValue(input)
        local pos = math.clamp((input.Position.X - sliderBg.AbsolutePosition.X) / sliderBg.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
        local val = math.floor(min + (max - min) * pos)
        fill.Size = UDim2.new(pos, 0, 1, 0)
        valLbl.Text = tostring(val)
        callback(val)
    end
    
    sliderBg.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            draggingSlider = true
            updateValue(input)
        end
    end)
    
    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            draggingSlider = false
        end
    end)
    
    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if draggingSlider and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            updateValue(input)
        end
    end)
    return frame
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if char and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
        local hum = char.Humanoid
        local hrp = char.HumanoidRootPart
        
        -- Speed Modifier Logic with Lag Fix (>300 CFrame boost & normal base speed reset)
        if Config.SpeedEnabled then
            local targetSpeed = Config.SpeedValue * Config.SpeedMultiplier
            if targetSpeed > 300 then
                hum.WalkSpeed = 300
                if hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then
                    hrp.CFrame = hrp.CFrame + (hum.MoveDirection * (targetSpeed - 300) * dt)
                end
            else
                hum.WalkSpeed = targetSpeed
            end
        else
            hum.WalkSpeed = 16
        end

        if Config.JumpEnabled then
            hum.JumpPower = Config.JumpValue
        end

        if Config.BhopEnabled then
            if hum.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air then
                hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
            end
        end

        if Config.SpinbotEnabled then
            hrp.CFrame = hrp.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(Config.SpinbotSpeed), 0)
        end

        if Config.WalkOnWaterEnabled then
            waterPlatform.Position = Vector3.new(hrp.Position.X, 0, hrp.Position.Z)
            waterPlatform.CanCollide = true
        else
            waterPlatform.CanCollide = false
        end

        if Config.NoclipEnabled then
            for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
                if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                    part.CanCollide = false
                end
            end
        end

        if Config.HitboxEnabled then
            for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                    local targetHrp = p.Character.HumanoidRootPart
                    if Config.HitboxInf then
                        targetHrp.Size = Vector3.new(9999, 9999, 9999)
                    else
                        targetHrp.Size = Vector3.new(Config.HitboxSize, Config.HitboxSize, Config.HitboxSize)
                    end
                    targetHrp.Transparency = 0.7
                    targetHrp.CanCollide = false
                end
            end
        end

        if Config.AimbotEnabled then
            local closestPlayer = nil
            local shortestDist = math.huge
            for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                    local dist = (hrp.Position - p.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude
                    if dist < shortestDist then
                        shortestDist = dist
                        closestPlayer = p
                    end
                end
            end

local function toSmallCaps(str)
	local result = ""
	local inTag = false
	for i = 1, #str do
		local char = str:sub(i, i)
		if char == "<" then inTag = true end
		if inTag then

	local colors = {
		Color3.fromRGB(40, 0, 10),
		Color3.fromRGB(255, 15, 45),
		Color3.fromRGB(180, 0, 60),
		Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 120)
	}
	local t = (os.clock() * (speedMultiplier or 1.2)) % #colors
	local index = math.floor(t) + 1
	local nextIndex = (index % #colors) + 1
	local alpha = t - math.floor(t)
	local smoothAlpha = (1 - math.cos(alpha * math.pi)) / 2
	return colors[index]:Lerp(colors[nextIndex], smoothAlpha)

local function makeMovable(element)
	task.spawn(function()
		local dragging = false
		local dragInput, dragStart, startPos
		element.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
				dragging = true
				dragStart = input.Position
				startPos = element.Position
				input.Changed:Connect(function()
					if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
						dragging = false
					end
				end)
			end
		end)
		element.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
				dragInput = input
			end
		end)
		UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
			if input == dragInput and dragging then
				local delta = input.Position - dragStart
				element.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
			end
		end)
	end)
end

local function getUniqueRandomWords(sourceTable, targetAmount)
	local indices = {}
	local chosenWords = {}
	while #chosenWords < targetAmount do
		local randIndex = math.random(1, #sourceTable)
		if not indices[randIndex] then
			indices[randIndex] = true
			table.insert(chosenWords, string.upper(sourceTable[randIndex]))
		end
		if #chosenWords >= #sourceTable then break end
	end
	return table.concat(chosenWords, " ")
end

local function send(msg)
	pcall(function()
		if TextChatService.ChatVersion == Enum.ChatVersion.TextChatService then
			local ch = TextChatService.TextChannels:FindFirstChild("RBXGeneral")
			if ch then
				ch:SendAsync(msg)
			end
		else
			local legacyChat = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("DefaultChatSystemChatEvents")
			if legacyChat and legacyChat:FindFirstChild("SayMessageRequest") then
				legacyChat.SayMessageRequest:FireServer(msg, "All")
			end
		end
	end)
end

local function runSpamLoop()
	task.spawn(function()
		local cycleIdx = 1
		local globalMessageCounter = 0
		local standaloneModeCycleCounter = 1
		while running do
			local sp = tonumber(speed.Text) or 0.8
			for i, b in ipairs(names) do
				if not running then break end
				if b.Text ~= "" then
					if megaAntiTagMode and megaAntiTagTriggeredLoop then
						selected = prefixes[megaPrefixIndex]
						megaPrefixIndex = megaPrefixIndex + 1
						if megaPrefixIndex > #prefixes then
							megaPrefixIndex = 1
							currentActiveAutomatedMode = currentActiveAutomatedMode + 1
							if currentActiveAutomatedMode > 3 then currentActiveAutomatedMode = 1 end
							resetAllToggles()
							if currentActiveAutomatedMode == 1 then
								selectTmxMareVisual()
							elseif currentActiveAutomatedMode == 2 then
								selectAnimalKudaiVisual()
							else
								selectWord9Visual()
							end
						end
					elseif modesCycleMode and not megaAntiTagTriggeredLoop then
						resetAllToggles()
						if standaloneModeCycleCounter == 1 then
							selectTmxMareVisual()
						elseif standaloneModeCycleCounter == 2 then
							selectAnimalKudaiVisual()
						else
							selectWord9Visual()
						end
						standaloneModeCycleCounter = standaloneModeCycleCounter >= 3 and 1 or standaloneModeCycleCounter + 1
					end
					local currentPrefix = selected
					if cycleMode and not megaAntiTagTriggeredLoop and not megaAntiTagMode and not antiTagMode then
						currentPrefix = prefixes[cycleIdx]
						cycleIdx = cycleIdx >= #prefixes and 1 or cycleIdx + 1
					elseif not megaAntiTagTriggeredLoop and not megaAntiTagMode and not antiTagMode then
						currentPrefix = lastUserSelectedPrefix
					end
					local limit = (currentPrefix == "@") and 110 or 80
					local finalP = string.rep(currentPrefix, math.ceil(limit/#currentPrefix)):sub(1,limit)
					local outputPayload = ""
					local targetDisplay = b.Text:upper()
					if emojiMode then
						local count = math.random(1, 2)
						local block = ""
						for _ = 1, count do
							block = block .. targetEmojis[math.random(#targetEmojis)]
						end
						targetDisplay = targetDisplay .. " " .. block
					end
					if animalKudaiMode then
						local rWords = getUniqueRandomWords(animalPool, 5)
						outputPayload = "["..finalP.."] ["..targetDisplay.."] TMx Kudai by " .. rWords
					elseif tmxMareMode then
						local rWords = getUniqueRandomWords(animalPool, 4)
						outputPayload = "["..finalP.."] ["..targetDisplay.."] TMx MARE " .. rWords
					elseif word9Mode then
						local rWords = getUniqueRandomWords(base9WordPool, 9)
						outputPayload = "["..finalP.."] ["..targetDisplay.."] TMx mai " .. rWords
					end
					if outputPayload ~= "" then
						globalMessageCounter = globalMessageCounter + 1
						if globalMessageCounter % 5 == 0 then
							send("@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@ [S C R I P T] BY N S S [ THE COMEBACK OF NSS ]...")
							task.wait(sp)
						end
						send(outputPayload)
					end
					task.wait(sp)
				end
			end
			task.wait(0.05)
		end
	end)
end

	cleanOrbTracker(targetPlayer)
	local tracker = {

		Rings = {}
	}
	activeTrackers[targetPlayer] = tracker
	local function constructOrbStructure(char)
		local hrp = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)

		local theme = OrbPresets[currentSelectedOrbTheme] or OrbPresets["Void Black"]

		local light = Instance.new("PointLight")

		light.Parent = core
		local auraPart = Instance.new("Part")
		auraPart.Size = Vector3.new(5,5,5)
		auraPart.Transparency = 1
		auraPart.Anchored = true
		auraPart.CanCollide = false
		auraPart.Parent = workspace
		tracker.Aura = auraPart
		local fire = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
		fire.Texture = "rbxassetid://243660364"
		fire.Color = theme.FireSeq
		fire.LightEmission = 0.8
		fire.Rate = 90
		fire.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.4, 0.7)
		fire.Speed = NumberRange.new(2, 5)
		fire.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
		fire.Size = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1.2), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0)})
		fire.Parent = auraPart
		local ringCount = 4
		local shardCount = 10
		for r = 1, ringCount do
			tracker.Rings[r] = {}
			for i = 1, shardCount do
				local p = Instance.new("Part")
				p.Size = Vector3.new(0.25, 2.5, 0.25)
				p.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
				p.Color = theme.ShardColor
				p.Anchored = true
				p.CanCollide = false
				p.Parent = workspace
				table.insert(tracker.Rings[r], p)
			end
		end
		local t = 0
		local smooth = hrp.Position
		local connection
		connection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
			if not tracker.Running or not char.Parent or not hrp or not hrp.Parent then
				if connection then connection:Disconnect() end
				return
			end
			t += dt
			
			local activeTheme = OrbPresets[currentSelectedOrbTheme] or OrbPresets["Void Black"]
			core.Color = activeTheme.CoreColor
			light.Color = activeTheme.LightColor
			fire.Color = activeTheme.FireSeq
			local shouldShow = true
			if targetPlayer == plr then
				shouldShow = adminAuraActive
			else
				shouldShow = checkIsAdmin(targetPlayer)
			end
			core.Transparency = shouldShow and 0 or 1
			light.Enabled = shouldShow
			fire.Enabled = shouldShow
			local targetPos = hrp.Position - hrp.CFrame.LookVector * 4.5 + Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0)
			smooth = smooth:Lerp(targetPos, 0.12)
			core.Position = smooth
			auraPart.Position = smooth
			local pulse = math.sin(t * 3) * 0.15 + 1
			core.Size = Vector3.new(4,4,4) * pulse
			for r = 1, ringCount do
				local ring = tracker.Rings[r]
				local radius = 2.8 + (r * 0.4)
				local height = 2.0 + (r * 0.7)
				local speedMod = 8 - (r * 1.1)
				local spin = t * speedMod
				for i, v in ipairs(ring) do
					v.Transparency = shouldShow and 0 or 1
					v.Color = activeTheme.ShardColor
					if shouldShow then
						local angle = (i / shardCount) * math.pi * 2 + spin
						local x = math.cos(angle) * radius
						local y = math.sin(angle) * height
						local pos = smooth + hrp.CFrame.RightVector * x + Vector3.new(0, y, 0)
						v.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(pos, smooth)
					end
				end
			end
		end)
		tracker.Connection = connection
	end
	if targetPlayer.Character then
		task.spawn(constructOrbStructure, targetPlayer.Character)
	end
	targetPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)

	end)
end

local function startFly()
    local root = getRoot()
    if not root then
        warn("Fly: character root not found")
        return false
    end

    if flyVelocity then flyVelocity:Destroy() end
    if flyGyro then flyGyro:Destroy() end

    flyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    flyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e6, 1e6, 1e6)
    flyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.zero
    flyVelocity.Parent = root

    flyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
    flyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(1e6, 1e6, 1e6)
    flyGyro.P = 9000
    flyGyro.Parent = root

    flyEnabled = true
    flyPad.Visible = true
    upButton.Visible = true
    downButton.Visible = true
    return true
end

local function restoreNoclip()
    for part, oldValue in pairs(oldCollisions) do
        if part and part.Parent then
            part.CanCollide = oldValue
        end
    end
    table.clear(oldCollisions)
end

local function setNoclip(state)
    noclipEnabled = state
    if not state then
        restoreNoclip()
    end
end

if not npcFolder then

end

local function createNPC(position)
    local model = Instance.new("Model")
    model.Name = "CyberTrainingNPC"
    model.Parent = npcFolder

    local function makePart(name, size, offset, color)
        local part = Instance.new("Part")
        part.Name = name
        part.Size = size
        part.Position = position + offset
        part.Anchored = true
        part.CanCollide = true
        part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
        part.Color = color or PURPLE
        part.Parent = model
        return part
    end

    local torso = makePart(
        "Torso",
        Vector3.new(2, 2, 1),
        Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
    )

    local head = makePart(
        "Head",
        Vector3.new(1.5, 1.5, 1.5),
        Vector3.new(0, 4.75, 0),
        LIGHT
    )

    local leftArm = makePart(
        "LeftArm",
        Vector3.new(1, 2, 1),
        Vector3.new(-1.5, 3, 0)
    )

    local rightArm = makePart(
        "RightArm",
        Vector3.new(1, 2, 1),
        Vector3.new(1.5, 3, 0)
    )

    local leftLeg = makePart(
        "LeftLeg",
        Vector3.new(1, 2, 1),
        Vector3.new(-0.5, 1, 0)
    )

    local rightLeg = makePart(
        "RightLeg",
        Vector3.new(1, 2, 1),
        Vector3.new(0.5, 1, 0)
    )

    model.PrimaryPart = torso

    local hum = Instance.new("Humanoid")
    hum.MaxHealth = 100
    hum.Health = 100
    hum.Parent = model

    local healthGui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
    healthGui.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(130, 28)
    healthGui.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 6, 0)
    healthGui.AlwaysOnTop = true
    healthGui.Parent = head

    local healthText = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    healthText.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
    healthText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    healthText.TextColor3 = GREEN
    healthText.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
    healthText.TextScaled = true
    healthText.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    healthText.Text = "HP: 100"
    healthText.Parent = healthGui

    hum.HealthChanged:Connect(function(hp)
        healthText.Text = "HP: " .. math.floor(hp)
    end)

    local skeleton = Instance.new("Folder")
    skeleton.Name = "NPCVisuals"
    skeleton.Parent = model

    local pairsList = {
        {head, torso},
        {torso, leftArm},
        {torso, rightArm},
        {torso, leftLeg},
        {torso, rightLeg}
    }

    for _, pair in ipairs(pairsList) do
        local a = Instance.new("Attachment")
        a.Parent = pair[1]

        local b = Instance.new("Attachment")
        b.Parent = pair[2]

        local beam = Instance.new("Beam")
        beam.Attachment0 = a
        beam.Attachment1 = b
        beam.Width0 = 0.07
        beam.Width1 = 0.07
        beam.Color = ColorSequence.new(LIGHT)
        beam.Parent = skeleton
    end

    hum.Died:Connect(function()
        for _, part in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                part.Anchored = false
                part.CanCollide = true
                part.Color = PURPLE
                part.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(
                    math.random(-25, 25),
                    math.random(15, 40),
                    math.random(-25, 25)
                )
                Debris:AddItem(part, 4)
            end
        end
        Debris:AddItem(model, 4)
    end)

    return model
end

local fpsBoostEnabled = false
local oldLighting

local function setFPSBoost(state)
    if fpsBoostEnabled == state then return end
    fpsBoostEnabled = state

    if state then
        oldLighting = {
            GlobalShadows = Lighting.GlobalShadows,
            FogEnd = Lighting.FogEnd,
            Brightness = Lighting.Brightness
        }

        Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
        Lighting.FogEnd = 100000
        Lighting.Brightness = 2
    elseif oldLighting then
        Lighting.GlobalShadows = oldLighting.GlobalShadows
        Lighting.FogEnd = oldLighting.FogEnd
        Lighting.Brightness = oldLighting.Brightness
        oldLighting = nil
    end
end

local function setShiftLock(state)
    shiftLockEnabled = state

    if hum then

            oldAutoRotate = hum.AutoRotate
            hum.AutoRotate = false
        else
            hum.AutoRotate = oldAutoRotate
        end
    end

    UIS.MouseBehavior = state
        and Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter
        or Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
end

    if hum then

        hum.JumpPower = jumpPower
    end
end

--==================================================

    camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

    local root = getRoot()
    local character = getCharacter()

    if noclipEnabled and character then
        for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                if oldCollisions[part] == nil then
                    oldCollisions[part] = part.CanCollide
                end
                part.CanCollide = false
            end
        end
    end

    if flyEnabled and root and flyVelocity and flyGyro then
        local camCF = camera.CFrame

        local direction =
            camCF.RightVector * stickVector.X
            + camCF.LookVector * (-stickVector.Y)
            + Vector3.new(0, verticalDirection, 0)

        if direction.Magnitude > 1 then
            direction = direction.Unit
        end

        flyVelocity.Velocity = direction * flySpeed

        flyGyro.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(
            root.Position,
            root.Position + camCF.LookVector
        )
    end
end)

local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local dragging = false

titleBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPosition = window.Position

        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)
    end

titleBar.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragInput = input
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if dragging and input == dragInput then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        window.Position = UDim2.new(
            startPosition.X.Scale,
            startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
            startPosition.Y.Scale,
            startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
    end
end)

        spawnButton.Text = "Spawnpoint ON"
    else
        spawnButton.Text = "Spawnpoint OFF"
        savedPosition = nil
    end
end)

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
    if spawnEnabled and savedPosition then
        character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        task.wait(0.2)
        character:PivotTo(savedPosition)
    end
end)

-- TP RANDOM CADA 5 SEGUNDOS
tpButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    tpEnabled = not tpEnabled
    tpSession = tpSession + 1

    if tpEnabled then
        tpButton.Text = "TP all ON"
        local thisSession = tpSession

        task.spawn(function()
            while tpEnabled and tpSession == thisSession do
                local availablePlayers = {}

                for _, otherPlayer in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                    if otherPlayer ~= player
                        and otherPlayer.Character
                        and otherPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                        table.insert(availablePlayers, otherPlayer)
                    end
                end

                if #availablePlayers == 0 then
                    tpButton.Text = "No players"
                    tpEnabled = false
                    targetPlayer = nil
                    break
                end

                                targetPlayer = availablePlayers[math.random(1, #availablePlayers)]
                local elapsed = 0

                while elapsed < 5 and tpEnabled and tpSession == thisSession do
                    local character = player.Character
                    local targetCharacter = targetPlayer.Character
                    local targetRoot = targetCharacter
                        and targetCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

                    if not targetRoot then
                        break
                    end

                    if character then
                        character:PivotTo(
                            targetRoot.CFrame
                            * CFrame.new(0, 3, 0)
                            * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(180), 0, 0)
                        )
                    end

                    task.wait(0.1)
                    elapsed = elapsed + 0.1
                end
            end
        end)
    else
        tpButton.Text = "TP all OFF"
        targetPlayer = nil
    end
end)

local function slider(title,min,max,default,callback)
 local box=new("Frame",{Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,67),BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(35,35,53)},content)
 corner(box,10)
 local label=new("TextLabel",{Size=UDim2.new(1,-15,0,25),Position=UDim2.fromOffset(10,3),BackgroundTransparency=1,Text=title.." : "..default,TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1),Font=Enum.Font.GothamSemibold,TextSize=13,TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left},box)
 local bar=new("Frame",{Size=UDim2.new(1,-20,0,8),Position=UDim2.fromOffset(10,43),BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(70,60,80)},box)
 corner(bar,8)
 local fill=new("Frame",{Size=UDim2.new((default-min)/(max-min),0,1,0),BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(235,110,190)},bar)
 corner(fill,8)
 local knob=new("TextButton",{Size=UDim2.fromOffset(18,18),AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5),Position=UDim2.new((default-min)/(max-min),0,.5,0),BackgroundColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1),Text=""},bar)
 corner(knob,20)
 local function update(x)
  local p=math.clamp((x-bar.AbsolutePosition.X)/bar.AbsoluteSize.X,0,1)
  local v=math.floor(min+p*(max-min))
  fill.Size=UDim2.fromScale(p,1)
  knob.Position=UDim2.new(p,0,.5,0)
  label.Text=title.." : "..v
  callback(v)
 end
 local active=false
 knob.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
  if i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then active=true end
 end)
 UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
  if active and (i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then update(i.Position.X) end
 end)
 UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
  if i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then active=false end
 end)
 bar.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
  if i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then update(i.Position.X) end
 end)
end

local function toggle(title,callback)
 local state=false
 local b=new("TextButton",{Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,42),BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(55,42,65),Text=title.." : OFF",TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1),TextSize=14,Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold},content)

scripts.author: Gilangboy
scripts.summary: Now is v3 V1 later because I uploaded it carelessly
scripts.code:
-- DTEXE V3 FE | RED BLACK EDITION
-- LocalScript - StarterPlayerScripts

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local plr = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "DTEXE_V3"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = plr:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local RED = Color3.fromRGB(190, 0, 0)
local BLACK = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15)
local DARK = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 35)
local WHITE = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)

-- Main window
local main = Instance.new("Frame")
main.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(250, 350)
main.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -125, 0.5, -175)
main.BackgroundColor3 = BLACK
main.BorderColor3 = RED
main.BorderSizePixel = 2
main.Parent = gui

local top = Instance.new("TextButton")
top.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 42)
top.BackgroundColor3 = RED
top.Text = "DTEXE V3 FE"
top.TextColor3 = WHITE
top.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
top.TextSize = 18
top.Parent = main

local close = Instance.new("TextButton")
close.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 42)
close.Position = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 0)
close.BackgroundColor3 = BLACK
close.Text = "X"
close.TextColor3 = WHITE
close.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
close.TextSize = 18
close.Parent = main

local reopen = Instance.new("TextButton")
reopen.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(100, 40)
reopen.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10)
reopen.BackgroundColor3 = RED
reopen.Text = "OPEN DTEXE"
reopen.TextColor3 = WHITE
reopen.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
reopen.Parent = gui
reopen.Visible = false

close.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    main.Visible = false
    reopen.Visible = true
end)

reopen.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    main.Visible = true
    reopen.Visible = false
end)

-- Drag support: mouse and touch
local dragging = false
local dragInput
local dragStart
local startPosition

top.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
    or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPosition = main.Position

        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)
    end
end)

UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
    or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        main.Position = UDim2.new(
            startPosition.X.Scale,
            startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
            startPosition.Y.Scale,
            startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
    end
end)

-- Scroll
local scroll = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
scroll.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 50)
scroll.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, -82)
scroll.BackgroundColor3 = BLACK
scroll.BorderSizePixel = 0
scroll.ScrollBarThickness = 5
scroll.ScrollBarImageColor3 = RED
scroll.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
scroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new()
scroll.Parent = main

local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)
layout.Parent = scroll

local padding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
padding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 4)
padding.Parent = scroll

-- Feature buttons
local function addButton(name, callback)
    local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
    button.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 38)
    button.BackgroundColor3 = DARK
    button.BorderColor3 = RED
    button.Text = name .. " : OFF"
    button.TextColor3 = WHITE
    button.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    button.TextSize = 14
    button.Parent = scroll

    local enabled = false

    button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        enabled = not enabled
        button.Text = name .. (enabled and " : ON" or " : OFF")
        callback(enabled)
    end)

    return button
end

local function humanoid()
    local char = plr.Character
    return char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
end

-- ESP
local highlights = {}

addButton("ESP", function(on)
    for _, h in pairs(highlights) do
        h:Destroy()
    end
    table.clear(highlights)

    if on then
        for _, target in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if target ~= plr and target.Character then
                local h = Instance.new("Highlight")
                h.FillColor = RED
                h.OutlineColor = WHITE
                h.Adornee = target.Character
                h.Parent = gui
                highlights[target] = h
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- Fly follows camera
local flying = false
local flyVelocity
local flyAttachment
local flyConnection

local function stopFly()
    flying = false

    if flyConnection then
        flyConnection:Disconnect()
        flyConnection = nil
    end

    if flyVelocity then
        flyVelocity:Destroy()
        flyVelocity = nil
    end

    if flyAttachment then
        flyAttachment:Destroy()
        flyAttachment = nil
    end

    local h = humanoid()
    if h then h.PlatformStand = false end
end

addButton("FLY / UNFLY", function(on)
    if not on then
        stopFly()
        return
    end

    local char = plr.Character
    local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local h = humanoid()
    if not root or not h then return end

    flying = true

    flyAttachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
    flyAttachment.Parent = root

    flyVelocity = Instance.new("LinearVelocity")
    flyVelocity.Attachment0 = flyAttachment
    flyVelocity.MaxForce = math.huge
    flyVelocity.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
    flyVelocity.VectorVelocity = Vector3.zero
    flyVelocity.Parent = root

    h.PlatformStand = true

    flyConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local direction = Vector3.zero

        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then
            direction += cam.CFrame.LookVector
        end
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then
            direction -= cam.CFrame.LookVector
        end
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then
            direction -= cam.CFrame.RightVector
        end
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then
            direction += cam.CFrame.RightVector
        end

        flyVelocity.VectorVelocity = direction * 55
    end)
end)

-- Noclip
local noclipConnection
addButton("NOCLIP", function(on)
    if noclipConnection then
        noclipConnection:Disconnect()
        noclipConnection = nil
    end

    if on then
        noclipConnection = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
            local char = plr.Character
            if char then
                for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
                    if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                        part.CanCollide = false
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    else
        local char = plr.Character
        if char then
            for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
                if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                    part.CanCollide = true
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- Infinite Jump
local jumpConnection
addButton("INFINITE JUMP", function(on)
    if jumpConnection then
        jumpConnection:Disconnect()
        jumpConnection = nil
    end

    if on then
        jumpConnection = UIS.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
            local h = humanoid()
            if h then
                h:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
            end
        end)
    end
end)

-- Super Jump
addButton("SUPER JUMP", function(on)
    local h = humanoid()
    if h then
        h.UseJumpPower = true
        h.JumpPower = on and 100 or 50
    end
end)

-- Low Gravity
addButton("LOW GRAVITY", function(on)
    local h = humanoid()
    if h then
        h.JumpHeight = on and 15 or 7.2
    end
end)

-- Speed
addButton("SPEED UP", function(on)
    local h = humanoid()
    if h then
        h.WalkSpeed = on and 50 or 16
    end
end)

-- Get Gun
local gunButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
gunButton.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 38)
gunButton.BackgroundColor3 = DARK
gunButton.BorderColor3 = RED
gunButton.Text = "GET GUN"
gunButton.TextColor3 = WHITE
gunButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
gunButton.Parent = scroll

gunButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    warn("GET GUN: Hub needs a supported weapon system.")
end)

-- Footer
local footer = Instance.new("TextLabel")
footer.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 28)
footer.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -28)
footer.BackgroundColor3 = RED
footer.Text = "DTEXE TEAM"
footer.TextColor3 = WHITE
footer.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
footer.TextSize = 14
footer.Parent = main

-- Cleanup
plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    stopFly()
end)

-- Encode function
local function encode(text)
	local parts = {}

	for _, codepoint in utf8.codes(text) do
		table.insert(parts, "utf8.char(" .. codepoint .. ")")
	end
	
	local str = table.concat(parts, " .. "):sub(1, -1)

	return "local str = " .. str
end

--[[
    T1337.vlone — Dev Menu
    ESP (Highlight / Fill) + AimBot + Fly
    Использовать ТОЛЬКО в своей игре или тестовом плейсе.

    Управление:
      • Кнопка ≡ в левом верхнем углу — открыть/закрыть меню
      • RightShift — дублирует кнопку
      • R — AimBot
      • F — Fly

    Fly:
      • Направление движения задаётся ТОЛЬКО камерой
      • W/S — вперёд/назад по взгляду камеры
      • A/D — стрейф вбок от камеры
      • Space/LShift — вверх/вниз
      • Тело разворачивается вслед за камерой

    AimBot: FOV-круг по центру экрана, цели ищутся от центра.
]]

local Players       = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService    = game:GetService("RunService")
local UIS           = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Tween         = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Camera        = workspace.CurrentCamera
local LP            = Players.LocalPlayer

local Drawing = rawget(getfenv(), "Drawing") or nil

-- ================== НАЗВАНИЕ МЕНЮ ==================
local MENU_TITLE = "T1337.vlone"
-- ====================================================

-- ================== РОДИТЕЛЬ GUI ==================
local function GetGuiParent()
    local ok, hui = pcall(function() return gethui() end)
    if ok and hui then return hui end
    local ok2, cg = pcall(function() return game:GetService("CoreGui") end)
    if ok2 and cg then return cg end
    return LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
end

-- ================== CLEANUP ПРЕДЫДУЩЕГО ЗАПУСКА ==================
local function SafeDestroyGuiIn(parent)
    if not parent then return end
    local ok, existing = pcall(function() return parent:FindFirstChild("TEST_DevMenu") end)
    if ok and existing then existing:Destroy() end
end

-- 1) Удаляем старые ScreenGui во всех возможных родителях
pcall(function() SafeDestroyGuiIn(gethui()) end)
pcall(function() SafeDestroyGuiIn(game:GetService("CoreGui")) end)
pcall(function() SafeDestroyGuiIn(LP:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")) end)

-- 2) Чистим остатки (Highlight, BillboardGui, BodyVelocity, BodyGyro) со всех персонажей
local function CleanChar(ch)
    if not ch then return end
    for _, obj in ipairs(ch:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj.Name == "TEST_ESP_Fill"
        or obj.Name == "TEST_ESP_Info"
        or obj.Name == "TEST_FlyBV"
        or obj.Name == "TEST_FlyBG" then
            obj:Destroy()
        end
    end
    local hrp = ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if hrp then
        for _, obj in ipairs(hrp:GetChildren()) do
            if obj.Name == "TEST_FlyBV" or obj.Name == "TEST_FlyBG" then
                obj:Destroy()
            end
        end
    end
    local hum = ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if hum then
        hum.PlatformStand = false
        hum.WalkSpeed     = 16
        hum.AutoRotate    = true
    end
end

for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do CleanChar(p.Character) end
CleanChar(LP.Character)

-- ================== CONFIG ==================
local CFG = {
    ESP = {
        Enabled          = true,
        FillEnabled      = true,
        FillColor        = Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 100),
        FillTransparency = 0.55,

-- ================== UI HELPERS ==================
local function New(class, props, parent)
    local i = Instance.new(class)
    for k, v in pairs(props) do i[k] = v end
    if parent then i.Parent = parent end
    return i
end

local function Corner(parent, r)
    New("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, r or 6)}, parent)
end

-- Drag: игнорируем нажатия на кнопки (иначе клик по ✕ не срабатывает)
local function MakeDraggable(frame, dragBar)
    local dragging, dragStart, startPos
    dragBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            local t = input.Target
            if t and t:IsA("GuiButton") then return end
            dragging, dragStart, startPos = true, input.Position, frame.Position
        end
    end)
    UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if dragging and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
            local d = input.Position - dragStart
            frame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + d.X,
                                       startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + d.Y)
        end
    end)
    UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then dragging = false end
    end)
end

local function MakeToggle(parent, text, initial, callback)
    local c = New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 26), BackgroundTransparency = 1}, parent)
    New("TextLabel", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -50, 1, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = text, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(225,225,230),
        TextSize = 13, Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
    }, c)
    local btn = New("TextButton", {
        Size = UDim2.new(0, 34, 0, 18), Position = UDim2.new(1, -34, 0.5, -9),
        BackgroundColor3 = initial and Color3.fromRGB(0,180,90) or Color3.fromRGB(60,60,70),
        Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false,
    }, c); Corner(btn, 9)
    local knob = New("Frame", {
        Size = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 14),
        Position = initial and UDim2.new(1, -16, 0.5, -7) or UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.5, -7),
        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255), BorderSizePixel = 0,
    }, btn); Corner(knob, 7)

    local state = initial
    local function set(n)
        state = n
        Tween:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {BackgroundColor3 = state and Color3.fromRGB(0,180,90) or Color3.fromRGB(60,60,70)}):Play()
        Tween:Create(knob, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {Position = state and UDim2.new(1, -16, 0.5, -7) or UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.5, -7)}):Play()
        if callback then callback(state) end
    end
    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() set(not state) end)
    return {Set = set, Get = function() return state end, Frame = c}
end

local function MakeSlider(parent, text, min, max, initial, callback)
    local c = New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 42), BackgroundTransparency = 1}, parent)
    New("TextLabel", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -60, 0, 16), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = text, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(225,225,230),
        TextSize = 13, Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
    }, c)
    local val = New("TextLabel", {
        Size = UDim2.new(0, 60, 0, 16), Position = UDim2.new(1, -60, 0, 0),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = tostring(math.floor(initial)),
        TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140,190,255), TextSize = 13,
        Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
    }, c)
    local barBg = New("Frame", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 6), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 26),
        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40,40,50), BorderSizePixel = 0,
    }, c); Corner(barBg, 3)
    local fill = New("Frame", {
        Size = UDim2.new((initial - min) / (max - min), 0, 1, 0),
        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100,150,255), BorderSizePixel = 0,
    }, barBg); Corner(fill, 3)
    local hit = New("TextButton", {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = ""}, barBg)

    local dragging = false
    local function upd(x)
        local rel = math.clamp((x - barBg.AbsolutePosition.X) / barBg.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
        local v = min + (max - min) * rel
        fill.Size = UDim2.new(rel, 0, 1, 0)
        val.Text = string.format("%d", math.floor(v))
        callback(v)
    end
    hit.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then dragging = true; upd(i.Position.X) end
    end)
    UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
        if dragging and i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then upd(i.Position.X) end
    end)
    UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then dragging = false end
    end)
    return c
end

local function MakeColorPicker(parent, text, initial, callback)
    local c = New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 46), BackgroundTransparency = 1}, parent)
    New("TextLabel", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 18), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = text, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(225,225,230),
        TextSize = 13, Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
    }, c)
    local swatch = New("Frame", {
        Size = UDim2.new(0, 22, 0, 14), Position = UDim2.new(1, -22, 0, 2),
        BackgroundColor3 = initial, BorderSizePixel = 0,
    }, c); Corner(swatch, 3)

    local row = New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20),
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 22), BackgroundTransparency = 1}, c)

    local cur = {R = initial.R * 255, G = initial.G * 255, B = initial.B * 255}
    local function notify()
        local col = Color3.fromRGB(cur.R, cur.G, cur.B)
        swatch.BackgroundColor3 = col
        callback(col)
    end
    for i, ch in ipairs({"R","G","B"}) do
        local chCol = ch == "R" and Color3.fromRGB(255,80,80)
                   or ch == "G" and Color3.fromRGB(80,255,80)
                   or Color3.fromRGB(80,80,255)
        local bg = New("Frame", {
            Size = UDim2.new(1/3, -4, 0, 6),
            Position = UDim2.new((i-1)/3, 2, 0.5, -3),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40,40,50), BorderSizePixel = 0,
        }, row); Corner(bg, 3)
        local fill = New("Frame", {
            Size = UDim2.new(cur[ch] / 255, 0, 1, 0),
            BackgroundColor3 = chCol, BorderSizePixel = 0,
        }, bg); Corner(fill, 3)
        local hit = New("TextButton", {Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = ""}, bg)
        local drg = false
        local function upd(x)
            local rel = math.clamp((x - bg.AbsolutePosition.X) / bg.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
            cur[ch] = rel * 255
            fill.Size = UDim2.new(rel, 0, 1, 0)
            notify()
        end
        hit.InputBegan:Connect(function(ip)
            if ip.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then drg = true; upd(ip.Position.X) end
        end)
        UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(ip)
            if drg and ip.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then upd(ip.Position.X) end
        end)
        UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(ip)
            if ip.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then drg = false end
        end)
    end
    return c
end

-- ================== ESP ==================
local ESP = {}
local tracerLines = {}

local function IsValidCharacter(ch)
    if not ch or not ch:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return false end
    local hum = ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    return hum and hum.Health > 0
end

local function ApplyHighlight(data)
    if not data or not data.highlight then return end
    local h = data.highlight
    h.FillColor           = CFG.ESP.FillColor
    h.FillTransparency    = CFG.ESP.FillEnabled and CFG.ESP.FillTransparency or 1
    h.OutlineColor        = CFG.ESP.OutlineColor
    h.OutlineTransparency = CFG.ESP.OutlineEnabled and CFG.ESP.OutlineTransp or 1
end

local function CreateESP(player)
    if player == LP then return end
    local function onChar(ch)
        if ESP[player] then
            for _, obj in pairs(ESP[player]) do
                if typeof(obj) == "Instance" and obj.Parent then obj:Destroy() end
            end
            if tracerLines[player] then tracerLines[player]:Remove(); tracerLines[player] = nil end
        end

        local hrp  = ch:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
        local head = ch:WaitForChild("Head", 5)
        if not hrp or not head then return end

        local data = {}

        local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
        hl.Name      = "TEST_ESP_Fill"
        hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
        hl.Adornee   = ch
        hl.Parent    = ch
        data.highlight = hl
        ApplyHighlight(data)

        local bb = New("BillboardGui", {
            Name        = "TEST_ESP_Info",
            Size        = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 34),
            StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0),
            AlwaysOnTop = true,
            Parent      = head,
        })
        data.billboard = bb
        data.nameLabel = New("TextLabel", {
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.6, 0),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            TextColor3 = CFG.ESP.NameColor,
            TextStrokeTransparency = 0,
            TextScaled = true,
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
            Text = player.Name,
        }, bb)
        data.distLabel = New("TextLabel", {
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.4, 0),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.6, 0),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            TextColor3 = CFG.ESP.NameColor,
            TextStrokeTransparency = 0,
            TextScaled = true,
            Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
            Text = "",
        }, bb)

        if Drawing then
            local line = Drawing.new("Line")
            line.Thickness    = 1.5
            line.Transparency = 1 - CFG.ESP.TracerTransp
            line.Color        = CFG.ESP.TracerColor
            line.Visible      = false
            tracerLines[player] = line
            data.tracer = line
        end

        ESP[player] = data

        local hum = ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then
            hum.Died:Connect(function()
                if data.highlight then data.highlight.Enabled = false end
                if data.billboard then data.billboard.Enabled = false end
                if data.tracer    then data.tracer.Visible   = false end
            end)
        end

    if player.Character then onChar(player.Character) end
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(onChar)
    player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function()
        if tracerLines[player] then tracerLines[player]:Remove(); tracerLines[player] = nil end

    end)
end

        if data.billboard then
            data.billboard.Enabled = CFG.ESP.Enabled and (CFG.ESP.NamesEnabled or CFG.ESP.DistEnabled)
            if data.nameLabel then
                data.nameLabel.Visible    = CFG.ESP.NamesEnabled
                data.nameLabel.TextColor3 = CFG.ESP.NameColor
            end
            if data.distLabel then
                data.distLabel.Visible    = CFG.ESP.DistEnabled
                data.distLabel.TextColor3 = CFG.ESP.NameColor
            end
        end
        if data.tracer then
            data.tracer.Color        = CFG.ESP.TracerColor
            data.tracer.Transparency = 1 - CFG.ESP.TracerTransp
        end
    end
end

-- ================== AIMBOT ==================
local function GetClosestTarget()
    local vp = Camera.ViewportSize
    local center = Vector2.new(vp.X / 2, vp.Y / 2)
    local best, bestScreenDist = nil, CFG.Aim.FOV

    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p == LP then continue end
        local ch = p.Character
        if not IsValidCharacter(ch) then continue end
        local part = ch:FindFirstChild(CFG.Aim.Part)
        if not part then continue end

        local worldDist = (part.Position - Camera.CFrame.Position).Magnitude
        if worldDist > CFG.Aim.MaxDistance then continue end

        local sp, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
        if not onScreen then continue end

        local screenDist = (Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) - center).Magnitude
        if screenDist <= bestScreenDist then
            if CFG.Aim.VisibleCheck then
                local origin = Camera.CFrame.Position
                local params = RaycastParams.new()
                params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {ch, LP.Character}
                params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
                local res = workspace:Raycast(origin, part.Position - origin, params)
                if res then continue end
            end
            best, bestScreenDist = part, screenDist
        end
    end
    return best
end

local flyConn = nil
local flyBV   = nil
local flyBG   = nil

local function StopFly()
    if flyConn then flyConn:Disconnect(); flyConn = nil end
    if flyBV and flyBV.Parent then flyBV:Destroy() end
    flyBV = nil
    if flyBG and flyBG.Parent then flyBG:Destroy() end
    flyBG = nil

    local ch = LP.Character
    if ch then
        local hrp = ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local hum = ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then
            hum.PlatformStand = false
            hum.WalkSpeed     = 16
            hum.AutoRotate    = true
            pcall(function() hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running) end)
        end
        if hrp then hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero end
    end
end

local function StartFly()
    StopFly()
    local ch = LP.Character
    if not ch then return end
    local hrp = ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hum = ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hrp or not hum then return end

    hum.PlatformStand = true
    hum.WalkSpeed     = 0
    hum.AutoRotate    = false
    pcall(function() hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics) end)

    local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    bv.Name     = "TEST_FlyBV"
    bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    bv.Velocity = Vector3.zero
    bv.P        = 1250
    bv.Parent   = hrp
    flyBV = bv

    local bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
    bg.Name      = "TEST_FlyBG"
    bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    bg.P         = 30000
    bg.D         = 1000
    bg.CFrame    = CFrame.new(hrp.Position, hrp.Position + Camera.CFrame.LookVector)
    bg.Parent    = hrp
    flyBG = bg

    flyConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not CFG.Fly.Enabled then return end
        if not hrp.Parent or not bv.Parent or not bg.Parent then StopFly(); return end

        bg.CFrame = CFrame.new(hrp.Position, hrp.Position + Camera.CFrame.LookVector)

        local look  = Camera.CFrame.LookVector
        local right = Camera.CFrame.RightVector
        local up    = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)

        local dir = Vector3.zero
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W)         then dir += look  end
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S)         then dir -= look  end
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D)         then dir += right end
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A)         then dir -= right end
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space)     then dir += up    end
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then dir -= up    end

        if dir.Magnitude > 0 then
            bv.Velocity = dir.Unit * CFG.Fly.Speed
        else
            bv.Velocity = Vector3.zero
        end
        hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = bv.Velocity
    end)
end

--script for my sempai:33

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Shooter = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shooter", 20)

local LP = Players.LocalPlayer
local GEN = (rawget(_G, "ANON_SHOOTER_GEN") or 0) + 1
rawset(_G, "ANON_SHOOTER_GEN", GEN)

local function alive()
    return rawget(_G, "ANON_SHOOTER_GEN") == GEN
end

local S = { gp = false, sb = false, passes = 0, err = "" }
local O = {}
local pass
local tearing = false

local function req(name)
    local inst = Shooter and Shooter:FindFirstChild(name)
    if not inst then
        return nil
    end
    local ok, m = pcall(require, inst)
    if ok and type(m) == "table" then
        return m
    end
    return nil
end

local function find_pass()
    -- the shared ctx table every panel module keeps holds the game's own pass object
    local order = { "MinigunTrial", "WeaponsPanel", "SandboxPanel", "HUD", "SideBar", "MainMenu", "Sandbox", "TracerPass" }
    for _, name in ipairs(order) do
        local m = req(name)
        if m then
            for _, fn in pairs(m) do
                if type(fn) == "function" then
                    for i = 1, 40 do
                        local ok, v = pcall(debug.getupvalue, fn, i)
                        if not ok then
                            break
                        end
                        if type(v) == "table" then
                            local c = rawget(v, "ctx")
                            if type(c) == "table" then
                                local p = rawget(c, "pass")
                                if type(p) == "table" and type(rawget(p, "isOwned")) == "function" then
                                    return p
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return nil
end

local function persist()
    if tearing then
        return
    end
    pcall(function()
        workspace:SetAttribute("ANON_GP", S.gp)
        workspace:SetAttribute("ANON_SB", S.sb)
    end)
end

local function apply_gp(on)
    pass = pass or find_pass()
    if pass then
        if on then
            if not O.is_owned then
                O.is_owned = pass.isOwned
            end
            pass.isOwned = function()
                return true
            end
        elseif O.is_owned then
            pass.isOwned = O.is_owned
        end
    end

    local gate = req("PassGate")
    if gate then
        if on then
            if not O.gate then
                O.gate = { wait = gate.wait, owned = gate.owned, confirm = gate.confirm }
            end
            gate.wait = function()
                return true
            end
            gate.owned = function()
                return true
            end
            gate.confirm = function()
                return true
            end
        elseif O.gate then
            gate.wait, gate.owned, gate.confirm = O.gate.wait, O.gate.owned, O.gate.confirm
        end
    end

    local tracer = req("TracerPass")
    if tracer and type(tracer.isOwned) == "function" then
        if on then
            if not O.tracer then
                O.tracer = tracer.isOwned
            end
            tracer.isOwned = function()
                return true
            end
        elseif O.tracer then
            tracer.isOwned = O.tracer
        end
    end

    S.gp = on
    S.passes = on and 7 or 0
    persist()
end

local function apply_sb(on)
    local sandbox = req("Sandbox")
    if sandbox then
        pcall(sandbox.forceOwned, on)
        pcall(sandbox.setActive, on)
        S.sb = on and sandbox.active == true
    end
    persist()
end

local COL = {
    bg = Color3.fromRGB(17, 19, 23),
    panel = Color3.fromRGB(25, 28, 34),
    line = Color3.fromRGB(48, 53, 64),
    text = Color3.fromRGB(228, 233, 241),
    dim = Color3.fromRGB(128, 136, 151),
    accent = Color3.fromRGB(255, 59, 92),
    on = Color3.fromRGB(61, 220, 132),
    off = Color3.fromRGB(40, 44, 54),
}
local FONT = Enum.Font.GothamBold
local W = 216
local H_HEAD = 30
local ROW_H = 28
local H_FOOT = 18
local H_OPEN = H_HEAD + ROW_H * 2 + H_FOOT + 8

local gui
local frame
local body
local chevron
local footer
local rows = {}
local open = true

local function label(parent, text, size, color, x, y, w, h)
    local t = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    t.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    t.Text = text
    t.Font = FONT
    t.TextSize = size
    t.TextColor3 = color
    t.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    t.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
    t.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
    t.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h)
    t.Parent = parent
    return t
end

local function tween(inst, props)
    TweenService:Create(inst, TweenInfo.new(0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), props):Play()
end

local function refresh()
    for key, row in pairs(rows) do
        local on = S[key] == true
        row.track.BackgroundColor3 = on and COL.on or COL.off
        tween(row.knob, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(on and 18 or 3, 3) })
        row.label.TextColor3 = on and COL.text or COL.dim
        row.dot.BackgroundColor3 = on and COL.on or COL.off
    end
    if footer then
        footer.Text = S.gp and ("GAMEPASSES " .. S.passes .. " · SANDBOX " .. (S.sb and "ON" or "OFF")) or "idle"
        footer.TextColor3 = (S.gp or S.sb) and COL.dim or COL.off
    end
    if gui then
        gui:SetAttribute("gp", S.gp)
        gui:SetAttribute("sb", S.sb)
    end
end

local function add_row(y, text, key, setter)
    local row = Instance.new("TextButton")
    row.Name = "row_" .. key
    row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    row.BorderSizePixel = 0
    row.AutoButtonColor = false
    row.Text = ""
    row.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, y)
    row.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, ROW_H)
    row.Parent = body

    local dot = Instance.new("Frame")
    dot.BackgroundColor3 = COL.off
    dot.BorderSizePixel = 0
    dot.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(2, ROW_H / 2 - 3)
    dot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6)
    dot.Parent = row
    local dot_corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    dot_corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0)
    dot_corner.Parent = dot

    local lab = label(row, text, 11, COL.dim, 14, 0, 130, ROW_H)

    local track = Instance.new("Frame")
    track.BackgroundColor3 = COL.off
    track.BorderSizePixel = 0
    track.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
    track.Position = UDim2.new(1, -2, 0.5, 0)
    track.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(34, 18)
    track.Parent = row
    local track_corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    track_corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0)
    track_corner.Parent = track

    local knob = Instance.new("Frame")
    knob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(236, 240, 246)
    knob.BorderSizePixel = 0
    knob.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 3)
    knob.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 12)
    knob.Parent = track
    local knob_corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    knob_corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0)
    knob_corner.Parent = knob

    rows[key] = { label = lab, dot = dot, track = track, knob = knob }

    row.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        if not alive() then
            return
        end
        setter(not S[key])
        refresh()
    end)
end

local drag = { active = false, moved = false, start = Vector2.zero, abs = Vector2.zero }
local dragged = false

local function viewport()
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    return cam and cam.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1920, 1080)
end

local function clamp_topleft(pos, size)
    local view = viewport()
    return Vector2.new(
        math.clamp(pos.X, 0, math.max(0, view.X - size.X)),
        math.clamp(pos.Y, 0, math.max(0, view.Y - size.Y))
    )
end

local function set_open(state)
    open = state
    body.Visible = open
    chevron.Text = open and "▾" or "▸"
    local h = open and H_OPEN or H_HEAD
    if dragged then
        local p = clamp_topleft(Vector2.new(frame.Position.X.Offset, frame.Position.Y.Offset), Vector2.new(W, h))
        frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(p.X, p.Y)
    end
    tween(frame, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(W, h) })
end

local function build()
    local pg = LP:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui") or LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
    for _, c in ipairs(pg:GetChildren()) do
        if c:IsA("ScreenGui") and c.Name == "ANON_Shooter" then
            c:Destroy()
        end
    end

    gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    gui.Name = "ANON_Shooter"
    gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
    gui.DisplayOrder = 200
    gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
    gui.Parent = pg

    frame = Instance.new("Frame")
    frame.Name = "Panel"
    frame.BackgroundColor3 = COL.panel
    frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    frame.ClipsDescendants = true
    frame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    frame.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
    frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(W, H_OPEN)
    frame.Parent = gui
    local fc = Instance.new("UICorner")
    fc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
    fc.Parent = frame
    local fs = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    fs.Color = COL.line
    fs.Thickness = 1
    fs.Parent = frame

    local head = Instance.new("TextButton")
    head.Name = "Head"
    head.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    head.BorderSizePixel = 0
    head.AutoButtonColor = false
    head.Text = ""
    head.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, H_HEAD)
    head.Parent = frame

    local dot = Instance.new("Frame")
    dot.BackgroundColor3 = COL.accent
    dot.BorderSizePixel = 0
    dot.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, H_HEAD / 2 - 3)
    dot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6)
    dot.Parent = head
    local dc = Instance.new("UICorner")
    dc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0)
    dc.Parent = dot

    label(head, "ANON", 12, COL.text, 22, 0, 100, H_HEAD)

    chevron = label(head, "▾", 12, COL.dim, W - 26, 0, 16, H_HEAD)
    chevron.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center

    body = Instance.new("Frame")
    body.Name = "Body"
    body.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    body.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, H_HEAD)
    body.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(W, ROW_H * 2 + H_FOOT + 8)
    body.Parent = frame

    add_row(0, "ALL GAMEPASSES", "gp", apply_gp)
    add_row(ROW_H, "SANDBOX MODE", "sb", apply_sb)

    footer = label(body, "idle", 10, COL.off, 10, ROW_H * 2 + 2, W - 20, H_FOOT)

    head.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            return
        end
        drag.active = true
        drag.moved = false
        drag.start = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
        drag.abs = frame.AbsolutePosition
    end)

    head.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        if drag.moved then
            drag.moved = false
            return
        end
        set_open(not open)
    end)

    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if not drag.active then
            return
        end
        if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            return
        end
        local delta = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y) - drag.start
        if delta.Magnitude > 4 then
            drag.moved = true
        end
        if drag.moved then
            if not dragged then
                frame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0)
                frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(drag.abs.X, drag.abs.Y)
                dragged = true
            end
            local p = clamp_topleft(drag.abs + delta, frame.AbsoluteSize)
            frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(p.X, p.Y)
        end
    end)

    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            drag.active = false
        end
    end)
end

local function namecall_hook()
    if STATE and STATE.namecallHook then
        return STATE.namecallHook("UserOwnsGamePassAsync", function()
            if S.gp then
                return true
            end
        end)
    end
    local mt = getrawmetatable(game)
    local old = mt.__namecall
    setreadonly(mt, false)
    local hooked
    hooked = newcclosure(function(self, ...)
        if getnamecallmethod() == "UserOwnsGamePassAsync" and S.gp then
            return true
        end
        return old(self, ...)
    end)
    mt.__namecall = hooked
    setreadonly(mt, true)
    return function()
        setreadonly(mt, false)
        if mt.__namecall == hooked then
            mt.__namecall = old
        end
        setreadonly(mt, true)
    end
end

local function teardown()
    tearing = true
    apply_sb(false)
    apply_gp(false)
    if gui then
        gui:Destroy()
        gui = nil
    end
    rawset(getgenv and getgenv() or _G, "ANON_SHOOTER", nil)
end

local function main()
    build()
    namecall_hook()
    refresh()

    local prev_gp = workspace:GetAttribute("ANON_GP") == true
    local prev_sb = workspace:GetAttribute("ANON_SB") == true
    if prev_gp then
        apply_gp(true)
    end
    if prev_sb then
        apply_sb(true)
    end
    refresh()

    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if cam then
        cam:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(function()
            if dragged then
                local p = clamp_topleft(Vector2.new(frame.Position.X.Offset, frame.Position.Y.Offset), frame.AbsoluteSize)
                frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(p.X, p.Y)
            else
                frame.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
            end
        end)
    end

    rawset(getgenv and getgenv() or _G, "ANON_SHOOTER", {
        state = S,
        set_gp = function(on)
            apply_gp(on == true)
            refresh()
        end,
        set_sb = function(on)
            apply_sb(on == true)
            refresh()
        end,
        open = function(state)
            set_open(state ~= false)
        end,
        pass = function()
            return pass
        end,
        teardown = teardown,
    })

    print("[ANON] panel ready · pass=" .. tostring(pass ~= nil))
end

if STATE and STATE.onCleanup then
    STATE.onCleanup(teardown)
end

task.spawn(main)

local function CallChatGPTAPI(userMessage, apiKey)
    local body = HttpService:JSONEncode({
        model = "gpt-4o-mini",
        messages = {{
            role = "user",
            content = userMessage
        }},
        max_tokens = 1024,
        temperature = 0.7
    })
    
    local success, response = pcall(function()
        return request({
            Url = "https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions",
            Method = "POST",
            Headers = {
                ["Content-Type"] = "application/json",
                ["Authorization"] = "Bearer " .. apiKey
            },
            Body = body
        })
    end)
    
    if not success then
        return "Error: Request failed - " .. tostring(response)
    end
    
    if not response or not response.Body then
        return "Error: No response from server"
    end
    
    local decodeSuccess, data = pcall(function()
        return HttpService:JSONDecode(response.Body)
    end)
    
    if not decodeSuccess then
        return "Error: Invalid response format"
    end
    
    if data and data.choices and data.choices[1] and data.choices[1].message and data.choices[1].message.content then
        return data.choices[1].message.content
    end
    
    if data and data.error then
        return "ChatGPT Error: " .. (data.error.message or "Unknown error")
    end
    
    return "Error: Unable to parse ChatGPT response"
end


local function CallAI(userMessage)
    if currentAI == "Gemini" then
        return CallGeminiAPI(userMessage)
    elseif currentAI == "Claude" then
        return CallClaudeAPI(userMessage, getgenv().ClaudeApi)
    elseif currentAI == "(Groq) Llama" then
        return CallGroqLlamaAPI(userMessage)
    elseif currentAI == "(Groq) Gpt Oss" then
        return CallGroqGptOssAPI(userMessage)
    elseif currentAI == "Gpt-4" then
        return CallChatGPTAPI(userMessage, getgenv().ChatGptApi)
    else
        return "Please select an AI model from the settings"
    end
end

local function ExtractCodeBlocks(message)
    local parts = {}
    local lastIndex = 1
    
    for codeStart, language, code, codeEnd in message:gmatch("()```([%w]*)\n?(.-)\n?```()") do
        if codeStart > lastIndex then
            local textBefore = message:sub(lastIndex, codeStart - 1)
            if textBefore:gsub("%s+", "") ~= "" then
                table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = textBefore})
            end
        end
        
        table.insert(parts, {type = "code", content = code, language = language})
        lastIndex = codeEnd
    end
    
    if lastIndex <= #message then
        local textAfter = message:sub(lastIndex)
        if textAfter:gsub("%s+", "") ~= "" then
            table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = textAfter})
        end
    end
    
    if #parts == 0 then
        table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = message})
    end
    
    return parts
end


local function DisplayAIResponse(message)
    local parts = ExtractCodeBlocks(message)
    local senderAdded = false
    
    for i, part in ipairs(parts) do
        if part.type == "text" then
            if not senderAdded then
                AddMessage(currentAI, part.content, false)
                senderAdded = true
            else
                AddMessage("", part.content, false)
            end
        elseif part.type == "code" then
            CreateCodeBlock(part.content, part.language)
        end
    end
end

    end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Character = LocalPlayer.Character
local RootPart = Character.HumanoidRootPart

local stages = workspace.stages
local currentstage = LocalPlayer.leaderstats.Stage

local function FindNextPortal()
	for i,v in pairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
		if v.Name == "Stage Teleport" and #v:GetChildren() == 4 then
			local enter = v:FindFirstChild("enter")
			if enter ~= nil then
				return enter
			end
		end
	end
end

local function Touch(Part)
	firetouchinterest(RootPart, Part, 0)
	firetouchinterest(RootPart, Part, 1)
end
while task.wait() do
	local CurrentStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value))
	local NextStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value + 1))
	local NextNextStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value + 1))
	RootPart.CFrame = CurrentStage.CFrame * CFrame.new(0,3,0)
	if NextStage then
		Touch(NextStage)
		--Potential Speed Gain?
		if NextNextStage then
			Touch(NextNextStage)
		end
	else
		local NextPortal = FindNextPortal()
		if NextPortal then
			RootPart.CFrame = NextPortal.CFrame
		else
			RootPart.CFrame = CurrentStage.CFrame
		end
		task.wait(1)
	end
end
for i,v in pairs(workspace.badges:GetChildren()) do
	if v.Name == "Platform" then
		Touch(v)
	end
end

local function notify(text, duration)
	local notif = Instance.new("Frame")
	notif.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	notif.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(32, 34, 36)
	notif.BorderSizePixel = 0
	notif.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	notif.ClipsDescendants = true
	notif.Parent = notifications
	
	local nCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	nCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 3)
	nCorner.Parent = notif
	
	local nStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	nStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(85, 90, 95)
	nStroke.Thickness = 1
	nStroke.Transparency = 1
	nStroke.Parent = notif
	
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, 0)
	label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 0)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = text
	label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 205, 210)
	label.TextSize = 11
	label.Font = Enum.Font.Code
	label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	label.TextWrapped = true
	label.TextTransparency = 1
	label.Parent = notif
	
	local textBounds = label.TextBounds.Y + 12
	
	TweenService:Create(notif, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, textBounds),
		BackgroundTransparency = 0
	}):Play()
	
	TweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {TextTransparency = 0}):Play()
	TweenService:Create(nStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {Transparency = 0}):Play()
	
	task.delay(duration or 3, function()
		TweenService:Create(notif, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1
		}):Play()
		TweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
		TweenService:Create(nStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {Transparency = 1}):Play()
		task.wait(0.25)
		notif:Destroy()
	end)
end

local visible = false
local animating = false

local function toggleGui()
	if animating then return end
	animating = true
	visible = not visible
	
	local targetPos = visible and UDim2.new(1, -290, 0.5, -190) or UDim2.new(1, 300, 0.5, -190)
	
	TweenService:Create(main, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Position = targetPos
	}):Play()
	
	task.wait(0.35)
	animating = false
end

hideBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleGui)

UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
	if gpe then return end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.P then
		toggleGui()
	end
end)

local processed = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local originalSounds = {}

local function optimizeGame()
	local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
	Lighting.Technology = Enum.Technology.Compatibility
	Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
	Lighting.ShadowSoftness = 0
	
	local function process(obj)
		if processed[obj] then return end
		processed[obj] = true
		
		if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
			obj.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
			obj.CastShadow = false
		elseif obj:IsA("Sound") then
			originalSounds[obj] = obj.SoundId
			if getgenv().StretchConfig.CustomSoundsEnabled then
				obj.SoundId = getgenv().StretchConfig.PopSoundId
			end
		elseif obj:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			obj.Texture = getgenv().StretchConfig.DotTexture
			obj.Rate = 5
			obj.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.1)
		end
	end
	
	for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		task.spawn(process, obj)
	end
	
	workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(process)
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	if not getgenv().StretchConfig.CustomSoundsEnabled then return end
	
	for sound, original in pairs(originalSounds) do
		if sound and sound.Parent then
			sound.SoundId = getgenv().StretchConfig.PopSoundId
		end
	end
end)

local function applyForceField(plr, character)
	if plr.Name ~= getgenv().StretchConfig.ForceFieldUser then return end
	for _, obj in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
			obj.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
			obj.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("White")
			obj.CastShadow = false
		end
	end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(plr)
	plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
		task.spawn(applyForceField, plr, char)
	end)
end)

if player.Character then
	task.spawn(applyForceField, player, player.Character)
end

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
	task.spawn(applyForceField, player, char)
end)

local holding = false

UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
	if gpe or not getgenv().StretchConfig.AutoSprint then return end
	if input.KeyCode == getgenv().StretchConfig.SprintKey then
		VM:SendKeyEvent(true, getgenv().StretchConfig.HoldKey, false, game)
		holding = true
	end
end)

UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.KeyCode == getgenv().StretchConfig.SprintKey and holding then
		VM:SendKeyEvent(false, getgenv().StretchConfig.HoldKey, false, game)
		holding = false
	end
end)

local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

local function fireproximityprompt(Obj, Amount, Skip)
    if Obj.ClassName == "ProximityPrompt" then 
        Amount = Amount or 1
        local PromptTime = Obj.HoldDuration
        if Skip then
